Chính sách mô tả cách GISA tiếp nhận và: This policy explains how GISA receives and processes information submitted through forms on this website.
Khi bạn chủ động gửi biểu mẫu, website c: When you choose to submit a form, the website sends your information to the receiving channel configured by GISA to respond to consultation, registration, contact, or partnership requests. If that channel is unavailable, the website displays an error and keeps your information in the form so you can try again; it does not display a false confirmation of receipt.
Tùy loại biểu mẫu, bạn có thể nhập họ tê: Depending on the form, you may provide your name, email address, telephone number, organization, job title, industry, message, or course of interest. GISA uses this information only to process your request and contact you when necessary.
Dữ liệu được truyền qua kết nối HTTPS tớ: Information is transmitted over an HTTPS connection to the receiving channel selected by GISA. The website does not retain a long-term copy in its source code or in your browser. Retention periods and access at the receiving channel are limited according to the needs of processing your request and GISA's applicable rules.
